headline: Precigen Reports Q3 2026 Results with Revenue Growth and Positive Cash Flow
summary: Precigen reported third-quarter 2026 financial results highlighted by a 37% quarter-over-quarter increase in PAPZIMEOS net revenue to $72.9 million and positive cash flow.
why: Precigen is a biotechnology company focused on the development of gene and cellular therapies. Quarterly financial results provide professional investors with critical visibility into the commercial adoption and revenue trajectory of flagship therapeutic products.

impacts.why: Stronger revenue growth and positive cash flow directly reflect improved financial performance for the company.
